product_metadata.title: Caroeas Laundry Basket Slim Plus 27.5”, Laundry Basket with Wheels, Laundry Hamper with Removable Wash Bag Waterproof Clothes hamper Fabric baskets for laundry
features: PRICE IS ONLY FOR 1 PIECE, THE OTHER ONE IS JUST SIZE REFERENCE!

Pro Plus 27.5 Size with Bigger Wheels - Rolling laundry basket is enlarged to size of 22x41x70cm-8.66’’x16.14’’x27.56’’ with bigger wheels, you can put more laundry clothes into the tall laundry basket and move it to elsewhere easily. Additional brake on the wheel can keep it still.

Foldable Structure for Easy Storage - You can collaspe the foldable clothes hamper to flat size of 22x41x8cm-8.66’’x16.14’’x3.15’’. And the detached laundry bag can be kept into drawer, cabinet, shelf, car to save space.
Removable & Breathable wash bag - Special designed drawstring mesh bag applied into the rolling laundry hamper enables you put clothes into wash machine directly or move to laundry room quickly.
Water-proof -The laundry room organizer is made of high-density cloth filmed with waterproof material ensure durable use. Laundry cart can be easily cleaned by damp fabric.
